_comment: Blacklist of opposing-verb pairs used to detect semantic conflicts.
_usage: audit.py's _detect_semantic_conflicts function collects per-token verb sets in each section; if the same token appears on both forbid and allow sides, it's reported as a conflict.
_token_extraction: Backtick-wrapped inline code or file path patterns. Examples: `task_create`, `cli/install.sh`, `hstl-oss`
_time_context_filters: Lines containing these markers are subject to false-positive mitigation (because they describe temporal change)
_exclude_sections: Sections matching these titles are excluded from detection (migration guides etc. intentionally show before/after side by side)
_min_section_distance: When two mentions are in different sections, distance is measured. Negative (-1) means unlimited — always detect within the same document. Positive values detect only within that distance. Policy contradictions within the same section should be detected unconditionally, so unlimited is correct.
